title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 六十八章 身世云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 六十九章 狭路
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
左边一排巨浪层层叠叠地卷了下来，登时将他连人带板掀飞起六七丈高。
小青大急，生怕他怀中的炼天石图就此同埋海底，忙道：“小色鬼，那俩魔头的脑袋能……能换取你们全……全家性命，可别让他死不见尸。”牙关格格打颤，口中直呵寒气。
漫天白箭似的雹雨中，隐隐可见一道淡淡的晶光，随着林灵素飞扬抛舞，正是那条苍龙筋。
许宣心中一动，背起小青，踏板直冲而起，几个起落，便已冲到了林灵素附近。他一把抓住龙筋，将小青与自己紧紧捆住，又猛地拽紧龙筋，将那魔头腾空拽了过来。
大浪冲天，将身下浮板推出十来丈远。许宣一个趔趄，险些摔入波涛。刚稳住身形，忽听一人雷霆般喝道：“孽障受死！”红光鼓舞，两道刚猛无匹的气浪朝他当胸撞来。
明心！
他心中一沉，待要闪躲已然不及。“嘭”地一声，左肩剧痛，纸鸢似的飞旋腾空，手中的龙筋被另一端的林灵素拖拽，顿时绷得笔直。
“噗！”龙筋嗡嗡剧震，又听一声惨叫，闪电乱舞，只见明心捂着脖子，又惊又怒地瞪着自己，鲜血从指缝间汩汩涌出，晃了一晃，翻身摔入海中。
林灵素哈哈大笑道：“秃驴假慈悲，害人终害己！贼老天啊贼老天，你终于开了一次眼！”
原来明心受了魔帝、妖后“盗丹气旋”的重击后，奇经八脉都已断裂，先前自忖必死，横下一条心，不惜以两伤之术强聚真气，震散大船，要与众人同归于尽。眼见许宣救起小青与林灵素，便凭借着最后一股未散的真气，突施猛袭。
岂料四周漆黑一片，他看不真切，又收势不住，竟然迎面撞在了那绷紧的龙筋上。
若换了平时，那龙筋纵再过强韧，也势必被他护体真气瞬间撞断，但此时经脉俱碎，真气又如强弩之末，竟几被这小小一根龙筋割断喉咙。
巨波涌动，白沫纷扬，明心一手捂着脖子，一手抓住浮板，随波逐流。突然，他的身子往下一沉，痉挛似的猛烈抖动，鲜血不断地在水中洇散开来，张大了嘴，双目圆睁，又是恨怒又是恐惧地望着他们，好一会儿，才从喉管里发出一声嘶哑凄烈的惨叫。
四周波浪分涌，十几个乌黑油亮的三角尖鳍朝他急速游去。浮板剧晃，明心随之猛烈抽搐，惨叫不绝，
“鲨鱼！”许宣大凛，急忙拽起龙筋，冲落到附近一块三丈长、两丈来宽的浮板上。
海面涡旋滚滚，明心已被群鲨拖扯，沉入水里，只剩下一只苍白的断手依旧紧紧抓着那片浮板，在不远处飘摇跌宕。
“哗！”一条长近三丈的虎纹巨鲨破浪跃起，一口咬住那只断手，从许宣左侧冲入海面，撞起冲天大浪。
小青惊得大叫一声，她虽是蛇妖，却久居峨眉，从没见过这等凶暴海鲛，眼看着自己平素最为畏惧的和尚就这般被撕扯得片骨不存，不禁心生寒意。
许宣定了定神，将龙筋的另一端打了一个绳结，呼呼挥舞，朝几丈外的李少微抛去。试了几次均未能够着，第七次终于套住她的右臂，急忙收紧，将她凌空拉了过来。
岂料身下浮板跌宕，他刚一使劲，竟一个趔趄，仰面摔入海中。只见四周气泡滚滚，灰蓝一片，数十条鲨鱼正在撕咬扯夺明心那苍白的尸体，瞧见二人，顿时炸开锅似的直冲过来。

小青被他缚在背上，又惊又骇，拼命挣扎却不得而脱。
许宣胆大虽大，此时也险些乱了方寸，一面朝上方游去，一面紧握龙牙刃，四下乱舞，将鲨鱼逼退。
他刚浮出水面，左腿突然一阵锥心剧痛，被一条鲨鱼咬中，急忙挥刀猛刺。那鲨鱼吃痛松口，挣脱游去，鲜血四处洇开。
许宣抓住浮板，奋力破浪跃起，翻身滚落板上，左腿被咬了六七个深达寸许的伤口，灼痛如烧。转头再看那条受伤的鲨鱼，还没游出两丈，已被群鲨猛烈围攻，顷刻间便只剩下一具白骨。
小青打了个寒噤，还没回过神，“嘭！”浮板又被鲨群从下方接连撞击，许宣急忙撕下衣袖，将大腿伤口紧紧扎住。
狂风扑面，就连那冰冷的雹雨中也仿佛弥散着淡淡的血腥。
content_en:
A row of huge waves on the left rolled down one after another, and immediately lifted him up to a height of six to seven feet, including his body and board.
Xiao Qing was very anxious, fearing that the Heaven Refining Stone Map in his arms would be buried under the sea, so he hurriedly said: "Little pervert, the heads of those two devils can... be exchanged for the lives of your whole... family, but don't let him die without seeing his body." His teeth chattered, and there was a cold breath in his mouth.
In the white arrow-like hail rain all over the sky, a faint crystal light could be faintly seen, flying and dancing with Lin Lingsu, it was the blue dragon tendon.
Xu Xuan's heart moved, he picked Xiao Qing up on his back, pedaled straight up, and after a few ups and downs, he rushed to the vicinity of Lin Lingsu. He grabbed the dragon tendon, tied Xiaoqing and himself tightly, then tightened the dragon tendon fiercely, and pulled the devil over in the air.
The big waves soared into the sky, pushing the floating board under me ten feet away. Xu Xuan stumbled and almost fell into the waves. Just as he stabilized his body, he suddenly heard someone yelling like thunder: "Death to evildoers!" Inspired by the red light, two fierce and powerful air waves hit him in the chest.
Mingxin!
His heart sank, and it was too late to dodge. There was a "bang" sound, and there was severe pain in his left shoulder. It flew into the air like a kite. The dragon tendon in his hand was dragged by Lin Lingsu at the other end, and it suddenly became straight.
"Poof!" The dragon's tendons buzzed, and another scream was heard, and lightning danced wildly. Mingxin was seen clutching her neck, staring at herself in shock and anger, blood gurgling from between her fingers, shaking, turning over and falling into the sea.
Lin Lingsu laughed loudly and said: "The bald donkey pretends to be compassionate, and it only harms others and ultimately harms itself! Oh my God, my God, you finally opened your eyes!"
It turns out that after Mingxin was hit hard by the "Elixir Stealing Cyclone" of the Demon Emperor and the Demon Queen, all his eight meridians were broken. He had previously thought that he would die, so he decided to use the two-injury technique to gather his true energy, shake up the ship, and perish with everyone. Seeing Xu Xuan rescue Xiao Qing and Lin Lingsu, he used the last remaining energy to launch a sudden attack.
Unexpectedly, it was pitch black all around, so he couldn't see clearly, and he couldn't hold back, so he actually bumped into the tight dragon tendon head on.
Normally, no matter how strong the dragon tendon was, it would have been instantly broken by his body-protecting zhenqi. But at this moment, the meridians were shattered and the zhenqi was as weak as a crossbow. His throat was almost cut by this small dragon tendon.
Huge waves were surging and white foam was rising. Mingxin covered her neck with one hand and grabbed the floating board with the other, drifting with the current. Suddenly, his body sank, shaking violently like a convulsion, and blood continued to spread in the water. He opened his mouth wide, his eyes widened, and looked at them with hatred and fear. After a while, he let out a hoarse and miserable scream from his throat.
Waves surged all around, and a dozen black and shiny triangular-pointed fins swam rapidly towards him. The floating board shook violently, and Mingxin twitched violently, screaming in agony.
"Shark!" Xu Xuan was stunned and hurriedly pulled up the dragon tendon and rushed down to a nearby floating board that was three feet long and two feet wide.
The sea surface was whirlpooling, and Mingxin had been dragged by the sharks and sank into the water. Only a pale severed hand was still holding on to the floating board, swaying not far away.
"Wow!" A giant tiger shark nearly three feet long jumped up from the waves, biting the severed hand, rushed into the sea from Xu Xuan's left side, and hit a huge wave.
Xiao Qing screamed in shock. Although she was a snake demon, she had lived in Emei for a long time and had never seen such a ferocious sea shark. Seeing the monk she was usually most afraid of being torn to pieces like this, she couldn't help but feel chilled.
Xu Xuan composed himself, tied a knot at the other end of the dragon tendon, waved it towards Li Shaowei, who was a few feet away. After several attempts without success, the seventh time it finally wrapped around her right arm, tightened it hurriedly, and pulled her over in the air.
Unexpectedly, the floating board underneath him swayed. As soon as he exerted his strength, he staggered and fell into the sea on his back. There were bubbles billowing all around, a sea of ​​gray and blue, and dozens of sharks were biting and tearing at Ming Xin's pale body. When they saw the two of them, they rushed over like a pot exploding.
Xiaoqing was tied to his back, andShocked and horrified, he struggled desperately but couldn't escape.
Although Xu Xuan was brave, he was almost confused at this time. While swimming upward, he held the dragon tooth blade tightly and danced around to force the shark back.
As soon as he emerged from the water, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in his left leg. He was bitten by a shark and hurriedly stabbed him with a knife. The shark let go after the pain, broke free and swam away, blood spreading everywhere.
Xu Xuan grabbed the floating board, struggled to break through the waves, jumped up, rolled over and fell off the board. His left leg was bitten with six or seven inches-deep wounds, which caused burning pain. I turned around to look at the injured shark. Before it could swim more than two feet, it was violently attacked by a group of sharks. In an instant, only a white skeleton was left.
Xiaoqing shuddered and before she could recover, "Bang!" The floating board was hit by a group of sharks from below again. Xu Xuan hurriedly tore off his sleeves and tied the thigh wound tightly.
The strong wind blew against my face, and even the icy hail rain seemed to be filled with a touch of blood.
